caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a rectangular shape, constructed from medium-brown wood with visible grain patterns. The cabinet is divided into three main sections: the upper section has two doors with round knobs, the middle section has a fold-down writing surface supported on each side by metal arms with multiple small divided compartments inside, and the lower section consists of two additional doors with matching round knobs. The interior of the middle section is a lighter shade of wood and is organized into small rectangular compartments, some horizontal and some vertical, as well as two small drawers on either side. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or features present.
title: Shaker Secretary
